# incident_catalog_entry_attribute_value (Resource)

This resource sets one attribute on a catalog entry that something else owns, usually an
entry that incident.io syncs, such as a schedule, escalation path or user. The sync owns
the entry and its synced attributes, so you can't manage it with `incident_catalog_entry`:
look it up with the `incident_catalog_entry` data source instead.

Use it for attributes you added to the catalog type yourself, for example with
`incident_catalog_type_attribute` or in the incident.io web UI. Terraform writes only
this attribute, and puts it back on the next apply if someone changes it elsewhere. When
you destroy the resource, Terraform clears the attribute and leaves the entry in place.

Don't also manage the attribute with `incident_catalog_entry` or
`incident_catalog_entries`: the two would overwrite each other.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "incident_catalog_type" "schedule" {
  type_name = "Schedule"
}

data "incident_schedule" "primary_on_call" {
  name = "Primary on-call"
}

# incident.io syncs a catalog entry for each schedule, with the schedule's ID as its
# external ID.
data "incident_catalog_entry" "primary_on_call" {
  catalog_type_id = data.incident_catalog_type.schedule.id
  identifier      = data.incident_schedule.primary_on_call.id
}

# An attribute you add to the Schedule type yourself.
resource "incident_catalog_type_attribute" "schedule_runbook" {
  catalog_type_id = data.incident_catalog_type.schedule.id
  name            = "Runbook"
  type            = "String"
}

resource "incident_catalog_entry_attribute_value" "primary_on_call_runbook" {
  entry_id     = data.incident_catalog_entry.primary_on_call.id
  attribute_id = incident_catalog_type_attribute.schedule_runbook.id
  value        = "https://runbooks.example.com/primary-on-call"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `attribute_id` (String) The ID of the attribute, usually from the `incident_catalog_type_attribute` resource or data source.
- `entry_id` (String) The ID of the catalog entry, usually from the `incident_catalog_entry` data source.

### Optional

- `array_value` (List of String) The values of an array attribute, each in a format suitable for its type. Set this or `value`.
- `value` (String) The value of the attribute, in a format suitable for its type. Set this or `array_value`.

## Import

Import is supported using an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) or the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import):

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an attribute value as <entry_id>:<attribute_id>
terraform import incident_catalog_entry_attribute_value.example 01HXYZ:01HABC
```
